versions.changelog:
- Initial release of fooocus-image-gen skill for local AI image generation using Fooocus (Stable Diffusion XL).
- Supports text-to-image, image variation, upscaling, inpainting, outpainting, face swap, and style transfer.
- Includes detailed usage guides for setup, configuration, and Web UI operation.
- Local only: No reliance on cloud APIs; all processing is offline.
- Provides troubleshooting, best practices, and checklists for consistent results.
